title: Watch — Sermons from Baker Road Baptist Church
metaDescription: Recorded services and messages from Pastor Marvin Rose at Baker Road Baptist Church in Baytown, Texas.
headline: Sermons and services.
intro: If you cannot be here in person, or you want to hear a message again, our services are on YouTube.

sections.note: Prefer to listen on the way to work? Every message on the YouTube channel plays as audio in the background. Put it on in the truck and let it run.

items.title: Our sermon channel
items.body: Recorded services and messages from Pastor Marvin Rose. Subscribe there and new messages show up on their own.

items.title: Baker Road on your phone
items.body: Our app carries messages, giving, and church announcements. Search your app store for Baker Road Baptist Church, on iPhone or Android.

items.title: Day to day news
items.body: The quickest place to see what happened last Sunday and what is coming up this week.
